name: Licensure, registration, and credentialing (REFUSED)
one_line: REFUSED, reversing the gist pass. The situation described here - proving a practitioner's authority to practise - is career.credentials-licenses' material with a health regulator standing in the issuer slot, which is a VALUE of an already-declared position, not a structure. Measured against the clinical_practice default template, its files do not differ from it but fall outside it: they carry one person, the holder, where this schema's defining signal is a second, differently-labelled subject. Its remaining content is a document-type list. Coverage is handed to career.credentials-licenses (certificates, applications, enrolments, renewals, notices), academic.continuing-education (the CPD reading), and the clinical_practice schema plus Protected Records (case logs and audit returns, the only members with a third party in them). Absorbs and retires the legacy rows med.clinician-licensure-credentialing and med.clinician-cme rather than rebuilding them.
refuse_reason:
REFUSED, reversing the gist pass's "kept, but weakly" verdict. The reversal is deliberate and is stated here rather than only in the memo: the earlier pass kept this row on the reasoning that the node test compares a template only against ITS OWN schema's default, and that the worrying overlap - with career.credentials-licenses, on a different schema - was therefore an edge rather than a refusal. That reasoning was correct about the test's shape and wrong about the outcome, because it never finished running the comparison it named. Run to the end, against the default template the deepened clinical_practice schema row now states explicitly, the row fails.

(1) LEG 1, FIELDS - unsatisfiable, and not a pass. clinical_practice declares no field rows (_CONTRACT rules 10 and 15, CONNECTION PR-6, D1's deferral as narrowed by J-IND), so a template on it can declare none. The schema row records this leg as “unsatisfiable for this row, and would be unsatisfiable in exactly the same way for every J-IND placeholder schema”, and this row inherits that finding rather than restating it. An unsatisfiable leg is not a satisfied leg; it simply carries no weight in either direction. The row therefore had to survive on legs 2 and 3, exactly as the schema itself did.

(2) LEG 2, DETECTION SIGNALS - the decisive failure, and the charge the row cannot answer. The clinical_practice default template is not a vocabulary; the schema row states it as a structure: an author or responsible-clinician block naming the holder BESIDE a separately labelled subject block naming a DIFFERENT person, both filled - the two-role structure - together with its batched multi-subject variant and its direction-of-address variant. Measured against that default, this row does not differ from it; it falls OUTSIDE it. A registration certificate, a good-standing letter, a privileging application, a panel-enrolment record, a CPD certificate and a renewal notice have exactly one person in them, and that person is the holder. The schema's own table reads this case directly: an author block naming the holder with the subject block absent or empty is “this schema at most weakly, and usually `career` or Independent Records”. This row is that table cell, promoted to a node.

    What is left once the two-role structure is subtracted is an issuing body, a credential title, a labelled identifier slot and a validity window - which is, item for item, the deterministic signal list already landed and argued on career.credentials-licenses: a credential title beside a labelled licence, registration, certification or member number; a labelled issue-date slot beside a labelled expiration, valid-through or renewal-due slot; an issuing-body gazetteer hit at a word boundary in the issuer position, where that row's own words are “a regulatory board, licensing authority, certifying body or professional association”; a verification affordance; a renewal email from a licensing board; a credential-ledger spreadsheet; and an archive manifest of credential-shaped members read without unpacking. Every signal this row proposed is one of those with a health regulator standing in the issuer slot. The issuer is a VALUE. 00 says where values come from and what they are not: “The system may create new values when it sees a new course, project, company, university, or event, but it should not invent new fields automatically”. A row whose only discriminator is which body appears in an already-declared slot is a value of a field wearing a node's clothes - the 574's original mistake, and the strongest charge against this row.

    Four residual structures were offered as the row's own. None survives.
    (a) A REQUESTED-PRIVILEGES OR SCOPE-OF-PRACTICE LIST. This is an enumeration of work types inside a document - the procedures the applicant asks to be permitted - and work types are values, not structure. It is also, structurally, the thing career.credentials-licenses already holds as the work type "registration or licensure application". A list of permitted activities on an application form is not a second labelled party.
    (b) A PAYER OR PANEL ENROLMENT DESIGNATION. A labelled provider-identifier slot beside an effective-date slot is the identifier-plus-validity-window pair, unchanged, with a payer in the issuer position.
    (c) A REVALIDATION OR APPRAISAL PORTFOLIO. Its structural claim was "an archive whose manifest names credential-shaped members, partitioned by requirement, read from the manifest alone". That is career.credentials-licenses' seventh deterministic signal with a requirement partition inside it, and the partition names document types. It is also a packet, and a packet is a GROUP, not a node: 00 - “A file may validly belong to more than one accepted group” - and its members activate on their own evidence rather than inheriting a clinical reading from the folder they were zipped into.
    (d) A CONTINUING-EDUCATION CERTIFICATE OR LOG. career.credentials-licenses already carries "continuing-education compliance record" as a work type and already names the group "a credential and the continuing-education evidence submitted to keep it", whose members it says sit on two different templates. academic.continuing-education holds the course-side reading. Nothing was left for a third row.

(3) LEG 3, PRIVACY RULES - no difference in either direction. This row proposed the Protected Records routing and the no-model-prompt rule from “Protected Records may represent sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials”. career.credentials-licenses states the same routing from the same sentence, adds the isolated-file licence “Rare but sensitive files such as passports, visas, and legal documents may be surfaced as protected records even when they do not meet a normal group-size threshold”, and adds the identity-spillover rule for a credential carrying a date of birth or a national identifier. The clinical_practice schema's own privacy posture is stronger than both and applies to anything that activates it. There is no rule here that is this row's and not somebody else's.

(4) THE DOCUMENT-TYPE CHARGE, CONCEDED. Strip the reasoning away and the row's content is a list: certificate, good-standing letter, privileging application, enrolment record, CPD certificate, logbook, verification response, renewal notice, disciplinary notice. That is a document-type enumeration, which is the charge that refused construction_property.compliance-certificate, and it is what the schema row forbids in advance: “A sibling justified only by "we hold letters" is the schema's default template with a narrower filename filter.” The work_types list is emptied in this pass for that reason; it is recorded in the memo as evidence of what the row actually was.

(5) THE DELETION TEST. Delete every organisation name (regulator, college, society, hospital, payer), every document-type word (licence, certificate, privileging, revalidation, credentialing, CPD), every person's name and every bare number - all constitutionally never-alone, the organisation name by read-across from “A university name alone should not create a group because Columbia can appear as an authoring school, course provider, target institution, employer, research venue, or merely a cited organization.” (provenance: inference; 00 writes that sentence about a university, and a professional body appears as issuer, employer, examiner, publisher and conference host by the same logic). What remains that is true of this row and false of career.credentials-licenses is nothing. A row whose entire support is never-alone evidence can never clear activation, and the brief states the consequence outright: such a row can never activate.

(6) THE ONE FILE THAT IS GENUINELY THIS FAMILY'S, AND WHERE IT GOES. Procedure logbook 2025-26.xlsx - a caseload return with a patient-record-number column, several hundred rows, many different subjects - was the gist row's best argument and the stated reason the row sat on this schema at all. It does not rescue the row, for two reasons. First, it is not a credential document: it is a record ABOUT other people's care that is SUBMITTED as credentialing evidence, and submission is a purpose, not a structure - 00: “Topic answers what a file is about, while purpose answers what the file was for.”. Second, it already activates without this row: it is the clinical_practice schema's own batched multi-subject signal, whose bulk-sensitivity rule the schema row states and owns, and it routes to Protected Records when no sibling situation fires. The purpose does not travel to the evidence: a group may hold the logbook beside the application without either copying facts onto the other - “The graph does not automatically copy those missing facts onto sparse files”.

(7) WHERE THE COVERAGE GOES, STATED RECIPROCALLY. Nothing is lost by this refusal; it is a hand-off, not an evaporation. To career.credentials-licenses: the registration or licence certificate, the good-standing or verification letter, the renewal notice and fee receipt, the membership record, the wallet or registration card, the licensure or privileging APPLICATION, the panel-enrolment record, the continuing-education compliance record, and the disciplinary or status notice about standing - all of which that row's landed work_types already name, so it absorbs them without amendment. To academic.continuing-education: the same CPD certificate read as a course completed, which is a both-rows file on that seam and not this row's to arbitrate. To identity.core-documents: nothing - a professional registration card establishes what someone may DO, not WHO they are, and that boundary is stated below in the file examples and does not change under refusal. To clinical_practice.malpractice-incident: a regulatory notice arising from a named care event stays that row's, and the conditions-on-practice notice it called a genuine both-rows file now has career.credentials-licenses on the other side rather than this row. To the clinical_practice schema itself plus Protected Records: the case log, the audit return, the anonymised-case member of a portfolio - the only members with a third party in them. Five landed neighbours (clinical_practice.json, practice-administration, teaching-material, patient-chart, malpractice-incident, veterinary-practice) currently route material to this id by name; this agent may not edit them, and the required reciprocal repointing is filed for R1c in open_question.

(8) WHAT WOULD REOPEN THIS ROW, so it is not reopened on the wrong evidence. Not a longer document-type list, not a specialty, not a jurisdiction, and not the observation that credentialing packets often contain patient material - the members activate individually. Only this: a named artefact, routinely kept, in which the holder occupies one labelled role and a DIFFERENT named party occupies another labelled role, whose relation the artefact records, and which career.credentials-licenses' identifier-plus-validity-window structure cannot read. If such an artefact can be named, it is a new narrow row named for that situation, not the reinstatement of this one. Minting that replacement id is outside what a single node agent may do.
proposed_fields_note: None, and none is deferred either. The gist pass proposed nothing and deferred to the clinical_practice schema row's single subject_of_record proposal, which was right and is preserved: no variant is minted here. A refused row proposes no fields in any case. Recorded for R1c because it bears on the refusal: career.credentials-licenses' one proposal, credential_expiry, is RECORDED, NOT WRITTEN under D1, and it is the load-bearing fact of this whole situation - a standing with an end date. That the concept this material needs is already proposed on the career side, by the row that already holds the files, is a further reason this row was a second copy rather than a second situation.

deterministic: None. This is the finding, not an omission. Every signal the gist row claimed is reproduced and disposed of in refuse_reason (2); each is a landed career.credentials-licenses signal with a health regulator, a hospital credentialing office or a payer standing in the issuer position. After that subtraction no structural signal remains that is true of this row and false of either career.credentials-licenses or the clinical_practice schema itself. Recorded so a later reader can check the refusal rather than take it on trust.

Recorded for the receiving rows, not claimed here: where a credentialing document IS readable, the reliable evidence is a labelled slot, not a layout - “Tables matter because resumes, forms, applications, invoices, and administrative documents often place their most useful information in cells rather than body paragraphs.” - and any gazetteer use is R4's with 00's discipline: “It should use word-boundary matching rather than substring matching.” This row writes no names and no regex.
needs_llm: Nothing is routed here. A clinically-flavoured credential document that matches no situation goes to the ordinary bounded model step against whichever schema its own evidence activates - in practice career - and then to a residual home if nothing lands: “A model that cannot cite sufficient evidence must return unknown.” The one model question this row would have owned, separating a licence to PRACTISE from an academic qualification, an employer competency sign-off, a training certificate and a society membership card, is career.credentials-licenses' already: it names the same problem as deciding whether the organisation on a certificate is the issuing authority or the employer.

Where two readings are both supported - a CPD certificate as credential evidence and as a course completed - the design decides the outcome rather than the model's preference: “conflicting signals should lead to abstention rather than an invented classification”. That seam is career.credentials-licenses against academic.continuing-education and was never this row's to arbitrate.
never_alone: a regulator, college, society, hospital or payer name alone - the load-bearing half of this row's candidate evidence, and a principal reason it cannot exist. Read across by inference from “A university name alone should not create a group because Columbia can appear as an authoring school, course provider, target institution, employer, research venue, or merely a cited organization.”; a professional body appears as issuer, employer, examiner, publisher and conference host by the same logic.

a certificate-shaped layout alone - a border, a seal, a signature line, a name and a date describe a course certificate, an award, a membership card and a licence identically. This was the row's tempting false file and it discriminates none of them.

a document-type word - licence, privileging, revalidation, credentialing, CPD - offered as structure. This is the other half of the candidate evidence and it is the charge that refused construction_property.compliance-certificate. A document-type word names no party and resolves nothing about any party's role.
a number-shaped token alone read as a registration number, and a bare 4-digit number read as a validity or cycle year.
a clinician title or post-nominal alone.
source_type or extension alone. 00: “treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning”
a parent folder named Credentials, Licences or CPD alone.
membership in a download session that pulled a portfolio's attachments at once - “A session should never be treated as proof of topic”
the absence of EXIF on a photographed registration card, read as proof it is a screenshot - “the system must not mistake the absence of EXIF for proof that an image is a screenshot”
the words revalidation, privileges or credentialing in a guidance document, which is ABOUT the process and is not anyone's evidence.

the two-role escape route, closed in advance. clinical_practice.patient-chart defeated a never-alone charge by showing that a relation between two labelled roles is not never-alone evidence, and this row would be tempted to read the issuing body and the holder across as two roles. It does not reopen the row. The issuer is an organisation name that has already been struck, and an issuer-plus-holder pair is the definition of every credential document in the corpus - a passport, a diploma, an insurance certificate - so it discriminates nothing and belongs to career.credentials-licenses in any case. Where a genuine second labelled party DOES appear, as on a caseload return, the file is the clinical_practice schema's own two-role or batched signal firing, and the row it needs already exists.

proposed_context_terms_note: Emptied in this pass. Thirteen of them are career.credentials-licenses' landed list or close synonyms of it; the remainder are document-type words, which refuse_reason (5) strikes as never-alone. Recorded in the memo rather than here, because a refused row must not leave a term list that looks like an activation surface.
work_types_note: Emptied deliberately, and the emptying is part of the argument rather than housekeeping. The gist row listed twelve: certificate, good-standing letter, revalidation portfolio, privileging application, enrolment record, scope authorisation, CPD certificate, CPD log, case log, verification response, renewal notice, disciplinary notice. That is a document-type enumeration, which is the charge that refused construction_property.compliance-certificate, and the clinical_practice schema row forbids it in advance: a sibling justified only by the documents it holds is the schema's default template with a narrower filename filter. Nine of the twelve are already career.credentials-licenses' landed work types; the list is preserved in the memo as evidence of what the row actually was.
grouping_reasons_note: Emptied. The five the gist row listed - one submission, one cycle, one credential's lifecycle, one re-downloaded export, and no group at all - are not lost: 'one credential across its lifecycle' and 'a credential and the continuing-education evidence submitted to keep it' are landed grouping_reasons on career.credentials-licenses, and duplicate_family and version_family joins need no domain row at all. Groups are P9's and are never roster nodes in any case.

template.why: Empty because the row is refused, and empty in any case by binding contract: clinical_practice declares no field rows, so no dimension can branch (_CONTRACT rules 10 and 15, CONNECTION PR-6, D1's deferral as narrowed). The emptiness is itself part of the refusal rather than an incidental fact - a template that recommends what its schema already recommends is the schema's default template under a second name, and this row's held-as-prose recommendation (the credential or the cycle, then document function, never time-first) is career.credentials-licenses' landed prose recommendation - issuing authority, then credential, then document type - with a clinical value in the first slot. Both rest on the same 00 sentence: “For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders.” And both are told to collapse for the ordinary holder: “It should recommend flattening when a dimension does not materially improve retrieval”. Two rows recommending one order over one set of files is one row.

collides_with_note: Empty, and emptied on purpose. A refused row never fires, so it can collide with nothing, and leaving edges here would let the row be reconstructed from its own JSON. The four seams the gist pass recorded are preserved as arguments rather than as edges: against career.credentials-licenses in refuse_reason (2), which is no longer a collision but an identity; against career.employment-records on the employment-contract fixture, a seam that now resolves entirely inside the career family; against academic.continuing-education on the CPD certificate, which is career.credentials-licenses' seam to hold; and against identity.core-documents on the registration card, where the boundary is unchanged and only the row on this side of it moves.

falls_through_to.why: The home for a credential record carrying a registry-verifiable identifier tied to a named person when no row accepts it, and for any credentialing member carrying third-party case material. 00 names this material inside the residual's own definition: “Protected Records may represent sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials; it should normally remain local-only and must not cause filenames or content to be exposed in model prompts.” 00 also licenses the single-file case, which matters because a refused row leaves more singletons: “Rare but sensitive files such as passports, visas, and legal documents may be surfaced as protected records even when they do not meet a normal group-size threshold”.

The home for a standalone certificate or notice with a durable purpose and no group around it - the commonest outcome for this material once the row is gone. “Independent Records may live under Personal/Independent Records and hold standalone certificates, notices, confirmations, forms, and PDFs that have a durable purpose but no broader group.” It is offered after Protected Records for any document whose identifier is readable.

The home for an isolated renewal fee receipt or enrolment confirmation. “Receipts and Confirmations may hold isolated invoices, delivery confirmations, booking records, boarding passes, purchase receipts, event tickets, and similar transactional documents.”

The cautious outcome for a certificate-shaped document whose issuing body and credential kind stay unresolved - and the honest destination for exactly the ambiguity this row was invented to absorb. “Review Later may hold files whose meaning is partly understood but whose final location requires a future decision.”

The home for regulator guidance, standards documents and process explainers that are about credentialing rather than evidence of it. “Reading Inbox may hold papers, articles, reports, and saved PDFs that appear to be reading material but have no active research, course, or project association.” Marked inference because 00's sentence is written about reading material generally, not about guidance specifically.

The safe outcome for a password-protected portfolio archive or an unreadable credentialing export. “Unsupported or Encrypted may hold—or, more safely, represent without moving—password-protected archives, unreadable documents, damaged files, and unknown formats.”

The home for a single photograph of a registration card that no row accepts, where camera EXIF is present and the screenshot reading is forbidden. Marked inference: 00 defines the residual, and reading a photographed credential card into it is this row's extension.

sensitivity_why: Recorded although the row is refused, because the material does not become less sensitive when its row disappears - it becomes MORE dependent on the residual routing above, and a refusal that silently downgraded sensitivity would be a privacy regression. 00 names it directly, twice: the corpus “can include identity documents, account statements, tax records, medical information, legal records, credentials, private correspondence, GPS metadata, employment materials, and educational records”, and the Protected Records residual is defined over “Protected Records may represent sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials”. Two aggravating factors, stated as inference rather than as design claims: a registration document carries a registry-verifiable identifier tied to a named person, and a credentialing packet routinely CONTAINS an identity document, a CV, references, disciplinary correspondence and case logs about patients, so the packet is more sensitive than any of its ordinary members - which under this refusal is handled by the members activating individually rather than by a row holding the packet. The ordering requirement stands whichever row receives the file: “Privacy policy must be enforced before content reaches any model or external connector.” This row assigns only the catalogue value potentially_sensitive; it does not assign, alias, rank or infer a P7 handling class.
open_question: Three, and the first is not this row's to execute. (1) RECIPROCITY OWED, and it is the largest consequence of this refusal. Six landed files name this id by name and route material to it: clinical_practice.json's collides_with toward career; clinical_practice.practice-administration, which says an individual clinician's own appraisal or revalidation portfolio 'supports neither, because the sibling clinical_practice.licensure-credentialing owns it'; clinical_practice.teaching-material, whose portfolio fixture calls a revalidation archive this row's material with teaching files inside it; clinical_practice.patient-chart, which sends the card-shaped files here; clinical_practice.malpractice-incident, which holds an edge here for the conditions-on-practice notice it calls a genuine both-rows file; and clinical_practice.veterinary-practice, which says the surgeon's own registration is this row's. Every one of those pointers must be repointed at career.credentials-licenses, which absorbs the material without amendment because its landed work_types already name it. This agent may not edit a neighbour and has not; R1c owns the repointing, and the memo repeats the list. (2) WHETHER career.credentials-licenses SHOULD BE TOLD ANYTHING. It needs no new field and no new signal to hold this material - which is itself the strongest evidence for the refusal - but it may want one work type it does not list, the hospital or facility PRIVILEGING grant, which is not a licence and not a membership and is the one item on the incoming list its enumeration does not quite name. That is a recommendation to R1c, not an edit, and it is a work type, which is a value: it is emphatically not a request for a node. (3) THE FOLD QUESTION IS NOW ANSWERED RATHER THAN ASKED. The gist row carried NJ-CP-2 asking whether this row should fold into career.credentials-licenses, and the clinical_practice schema row carried the same question in its own open_question (4) as one of the two rows R1c should look at. This pass answers it: fold, by refusal. If Joseph overrules that answer, the thing to reinstate is not this row as written - it is a narrow row named for the artefact identified in refuse_reason (8), and it does not exist yet.
